IN THE COURT OF HONBLE III ADDL CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE, HYDERABAD
Honored Sir,
The brief facts of the case are that on 31.12.2024 at 18:15 hours received a complaint from Sri. Ch Sravan Kumar Sub Inspector of Police, SR Nagar Police Station, Ph No 8712661077 in which he stated that on 31-12-2024 at 15.00 hrs he, received credible information that, at 15.30 hours one person aged about 20 to 25 years is coming to nearby S.R Nagar Metro Station area to deliver the MDMA which is Psychotropic substance to his customers. Believing information to be true and correct complainant informed the same to his superior officer U/s 42(2) NDPS Act and made GD entry of the details of information received.  The same information is reduced into writing and sent to the superior officer through PC:30001 MD Mashooq.  Complainant called the incharge of the Clues team over phone requesting him to come to the Police Station for the identification of the drugs.  Complainant requested two locality people to act as Panchas and they voluntarily agreed.  On enquiry they revealed their names as M Murali S/o Late M Shankar, Age:45years, Occ: Social Worker, R/o: H.No: 7-1-246/97, BJR Nagar Colony, Balkampet, SR Nagar, Hyderabad Ph:9989931386 and Udaya Gowtham S/o Bala Prasad, Age: 21years, Occ: Driver, R/o: H.No 5-182, Chintal, Chandranagar, Hyderabad Ph.No:9000770057 and they were also appraised about the information received. Then complainant along the his staff PC:4928 M Rama Rao, PC 30800 Aravind Swamy, PC:30001 MD Mashooq, HG:2585 V Srinu and clues team staff along with weighing machine, drug testing kit, laptop, mini printer and white papers, seizing materials and lac & seal left the PS in Government vehicle B.No.TS09PA4364. At about 15.50 hours they reached and concealed their presence by parking the police vehicle aside. Then complainant deputed two PCS PC:4928 M Rama Rao, PC 30800 Aravind Swamy, in mufti along with informant to keep watch on the suspect who is carrying drugs and to alert them on sighting him.  At about 16.35 hours the deputed PCs PC:5649 & PC:4928  and informant identified the said person who came along with another male person from Nature Cure MMTS Railway Station turning to Grave yard. Then complainant instructed to the Camera man of Clues team to take the Videograph of the entire proceedings till its conclusion. At the same time two persons came by walk from the Nature Cure MMTS Railway Station and entered into nearest isolated place i.e Grave Yard of BJR Nagar, S.R Nagar and they both were in discussion. Later the first person has given some packed item and the second one concealed the same in the pocket and remain pack was concealed by First one.  
Immediately the deputed Mufti PCs reached nearby them and on seeing them the two male persons tried to escape from there. We immediately reached there and took them into custody at around 15.55hours. On questioning, they revealed their names as 1) Kavalapara Vasudevan Saawan Krishna and 2) Bhukya Suman @ Suman.

Complainant appraised them about the information received by him and the reasons for their apprehension. On them about the information received initially they gave evasive replies but on further questioning Kavalapara Vasudevan Saawan Krishna revealed that he is drug peddler and today he came to deliver MDMA drug to his Business partner Bhukya Suman @ Suman and asked him to come to nearby Nature Cure MMTS, Railway Station to take delivery of MDMA and MDMA is present hidden in their pant Pockets, then complainant asked both the suspects, as per Sec 50 NDPS Act whether they are having any drug in their personal possession and the persons replied that they are having contraband in their personal possession. Then complainant explained them that they have a right to be physical search in the presence of Gazetted officer or magistrate and instructed them to give their consent. On that they opted to be searched themselves before the Gazetted Officer and submitted their willing and signed. Immediately complainant sent a requisition U/s. 50(2) of NDPS Act to the Gazetted Officer Sri. M Gopal, Detective-Inspector of Police, SR Nagar P.S, Hyderabad with request to visit this place to act as Gazetted officer for personal search of above suspected persons and sent the same requisition through PC:30001 MD Mashooq and he came to the spot. Complainant informed the accused persons that transportation, possession, selling of drugs is offence under NDPS Act. Then complainant moved one person in the custody of his staff to a little distance and called one person and upon the request of him, when they questioned him about his name, parentage and the reasons for his being in the police custody, he voluntarily made the following statement. 

	“I am Saawan Krishna, born and raised in Yellandu, Khammam District. My father, Vasu Devan, is a cool drinks distributor, and my mother, Nisha, is a housewife. My sister, Devi, works as an HR professional in Bangalore. I completed my SSC in 2014 from Montessori EM High School, Yellandu, Khammam District, and my intermediate in 2016 from Sahithi Junior College in Yellandu. Subsequently, I joined HKBK Engineering College in Bangalore but discontinued my B.Tech due to a lack of interest. At the time of education, I acquainted with one Zeeshan Ph No: 9986820290 and we used to consume MDMA in leaser timings. Then he gave the contact number of JP R/o: Banglore, N/o: Foreign National, Cell No: +2349063428065 who is the drug peddler. Since then I used to buy MDMA from JP when I required the drug. I later enrolled in Sahithi Degree College in Yellandu and completed my degree in 2022. After finishing my education, I began searching for jobs and eventually secured a position in Bangalore at Globiva Company as a Flipkart Customer Support Executive, earning ₹17,000 per month.

Further where I got re-connected with my childhood friend Bhukya Suman in Hyderabad I observed that most of the persons having habit of consuming drugs, if I sell drugs to them on higher rates I will earn more money. I informed the same to my friend Bhukya Suman who is drug seller and asked him sell MDMA drugs to the needy customers. For which he agreed and started supplying MDMA drugs to the needy people. Then onwards I am regularly visiting Bangalore and purchasing 10 grams of MDMA every time from one JP R/o: Banglore, N/o: Foreign National, Rs.2,000/- per gram and selling the same to the customers in Hyderabad @ Rs.4,500/- per gram and earning money illegally.  As of now I have brought MDMA drug for about several times from JP R/o: Banglore. We are selling MDMA to the following consumers by purchasing from JP R/o: Banglore.
1.	Venkat @ Venky, R/o: Hyderabad Cell: 7702997737
2.	Shiva, R/o: Kondapur, Hyderabad Cell No: 7013943695
3.	Charan, R/o: Madhapur, Cell No: 8897989003
4.	Goutham, R/o: Medhipatnam Cell No: 8106314008.
5.	Banoth Laxman, R/o: Balkampet, Hyderabad Cell No: 8179750632. 

Today i.e. on 31-12-2024 I called to my friend cum partner Bhukya Suman who is drug seller and asked to come to Nature Cure MMTS Railway Station to collect of MDMA drug for selling the needy customers during the new year celebrations. On my request Bhukya Suman came to Nature Cure MMTS Railway Station Lane and there we decided to go to nearest isolated place and we met in Grave Yard and handed over 04 Grams of MDMA in one Transparent Sachet. At about 15.55hours while we were in discussion Police came and caught us”. 

On further questioning in their presence about the MDMA, he opened his transparent Sachet (1) containing light brown colour crystalline powder from his right pant Pocket.  Complainant seized the same and marked P-1 and asked the Clues team incharge Krishna CSO Ph No: 8008078790 to test the substance, then the clues incharge took out a small quantity with a spatula from the P1, tested the contents of the cover and confirmed that it contains MDMA. The contents of P-1 is transferred into another transparent polythene zip cover and weighed its contents and it was weighing (06) grams and it is kept in a cloth lined envelope and sealed with lac and marked it M-1. The empty polythene cover of P-1 is put in another cover and packing a cloth lined envelope and sealed with lac and marked M-2. 

On further questioning in their presence about the money transactions with the consumers and suppliers, he opened his cell phone and showed the following financial transactions with the consumers and also informed that he used to send money through phonepe linked with his Phone pay No: 8919884648 to the Peddler through online to different scanners which were sent by him.

Further Complainant seized One Samsung Galaxy A14 Mobile Phone with SIM No: 8019980199, 8919884648 and IMEI Numbers 350650040012310, 354560660012316 of the accused and marked M-3 from the accused and pasted panch chits containing Panchas signatures, my signature and the accused on all the seized items. 

After recording the confession panchanama of Kavalapara Vasudevan Saawan Krishna, Complainant moved him to a little distance in the custody of his staff and called the second person and at the request of him, when they questioned him about his name, parentage and the reasons for his being in the custody of police, he voluntarily disclosed his name and particulars as Bhukya Suman S/o B Ram Singh, Age: 27years (D.O.B:13/05/1997), Occ: Rapido Rider, Caste: Lambada-ST, R/o: Road No.3, SBH colony, Hayathnagar, Hyderabad. N/o. HNo.21-14/2, 21 PIT, Rompedu, Polampalli Cross road, Yellandu, Khammam Dist, TG State, Cell No. 7396245861, 7569042086 made the following statement. 

“I am Bhukya Suman alias Suman, born and brought up in Rompedu, Polampalli Crossroad, Yellandu, Khammam District. We are two children to our parents, and I am the elder one. My sister Sirisha is married and lives separately. My father is a tailor, and my mother, Bharathi, is a housewife. I completed SSC in 2013 from Priyadarshini School in Yellandu, Kothagudem District. Later, I joined SRR Diploma College in Karepally, Kothagudem, but discontinued my studies due to a lack of interest. After leaving my studies, I assisted my parents with their regular work. In 2020, we migrated to Hyderabad and rented a house near Hafeezpet Railway Station. Since then, we have been residing there. My father began working as a daily wage laborer, and my mother started working as a sweeper in a private company. I worked for 1.5 years with Jio Fiber Services but left due to insufficient earnings. I then joined ACT Networks but eventually left that job as well. Later, I joined Rapido Rides and have been working as a Rapido driver”

Further where I got re-connected with my childhood friend Kavalapara Vasudevan Saawan Krishna in Hyderabad and he observed that most of the persons having habit of consuming drugs, if he sell drugs to them on higher rates he will earn more money. He informed the same to me and asked to sell MDMA drugs to the needy customers. For which I agreed and started supplying MDMA drugs to the needy people. Then onwards, he regularly visiting Bangalore and purchasing 10 grms of MDMA every time from one JP R/o: Banglore, N/o: Foreign National @ Rs.2,000/- per gram and selling the same to the customers in Hyderabad @ Rs.4,500/- per gram and earning money illegally. As of now my friend Saawan Krishna have brought MDMA drug for about several times from JP R/o: Banglore, N/o: Foreign National. We are selling MDMA to the following consumers by purchasing from JP R/o: Banglore, N/o: Foreign National. 
1.	Venkat @ Venky, R/o: Hyderabad Cell: 7702997737
2.	Shiva, R/o: Kondapur, Hyderabad Cell No: 7013943695
3.	Charan, R/o: Madhapur, Cell No: 8897989003
4.	Goutham, R/o: Medhipatnam Cell No: 8106314008.
5.	Banoth Laxman, R/o: Balkampet, Hyderabad Cell No: 8179750632. 
            
Today i.e. on 31-12-2024 my friend Kavalapara Vasudevan Saawan Krishna called to me and asked to come to Nature Cure MMTS Railway Station to collect of MDMA drug for selling the needy customers during the new year celebrations. On his request, I came to Nature Cure MMTS Railway Station Lane and there we decided to go to nearest isolated place and we met in Grave Yard and he handed over to me 04 Grams of MDMA in one Transparent Sachet. At about 15.55hours while we were in discussion Police came and caught us”. 

On further questioning in their presence about the MDMA, he took out (1) polythene cover containing light brown colour crystalline powder from the back pack. Complainant seized the same and marked P-2 and asked the Clues team incharge to test the substance, then the clues incharge took out a small quantity with a spatula from the P-2, tested the contents of the cover and confirmed that it contains MDMA. The contents of P-2 is transferred into another transparent polythene zip cover and weighed its contents and it was weighing (04) grams and it is kept in a cloth lined envelope and sealed with lac and marked it M-4.  The empty polythene cover of M-5 is put in another cover and packing a cloth lined envelope and sealed with lac.

Further Complainant seized One Oppo Reno Mobile Phone with SIM No:7569042086, 7396245861 and IMEI Numbers 862661055958397, 862661055958389  of the accused and marked M-6 from the accused and pasted panch chits containing signatures, signatures of seizing officer and the accused on all the seized items. The entire proceedings were video recorded by MD Rajaq SPO:0799  Video Grapher from his Camera as per his instructions. 

As per the information received, admission made by the accused, presence of contraband in the custody of accused and the confirmation given by the incharge of Clues team, Complainant has strong belief that the contraband present with the accused is MDMA.  Sri MD Rajaq SPO:0799 took videograph of the proceedings. The accused persons were informed about the grounds of their arrest to take into custody.
Complainant produced the accused persons Kavalapara Vasudevan Saawan Krishna and Bhukya Suman along with the seized 10 grams of MDMA and (2) Cell phones seized from the accused with a request to take necessary action on them under NDPS Act.  In this case other accused 1) JP R/o: Banglore, N/o: Foreign National, Cell No: +2349063428065 (Peddler) 2) Zeeshan Ph No: 9986820290 (Consumer), 3) Venkat @ Venky, R/o: Hyderabad Cell: 7702997737(Consumer), 4)Shiva, R/o: Kondapur, Hyderabad Cell No: 7013943695(Consumer), 5) Charan, R/o: Madhapur, Cell No: 8897989003(Consumer), 6) Goutham, R/o: Medhipatnam Cell No: 8106314008(Consumer) and 7) Banoth Laxman, R/o: Balkampet, Hyderabad Cell No: 8179750632 are absconding.
HERE WITH ENCLOSED ORIGINAL COMPLAINT
Received on 31.12.2024 at 18:15 hours 
As per the content of the above complaint I T Srinath Reddy, Inspector of Police registered a case in Cr. No: 1135/2024 U/s 8(C) R/w 22(C), 27, 29 of NDPS Act 1985 and took up the investigation. 
        Sd/-
T Srinath Reddy
Inspector of Police 
S.R. Nagar, Hyd.
